scope: Sixty exact mathematical arbitrary/any-selected quantifier forms: 58 non-headword libovol- spellings and two residual East-shaped proizvol- forms.
choice: Normalize the complete scoped family to the already established official libovolj- paradigm, preserving case, number, gender, and capitalization.
motivation: All 60 sites quantify arbitrary mathematical objects. The reader already contained 314 canonical libovolj- tokens; this removes an accidental spelling and source-stratum split without changing semantics.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining libovol-/libovolj-/proizvol- as three interchangeable strata leaves an unjustified mixed paradigm.
Globalizing type-2 proizvolj- would expand the East/South-shaped layer.
Svobodny means free rather than mathematically arbitrary.

evidence.semantic_review: Every site denotes arbitrary forms, rows, variables, elements, systems, polynomials, ideals, modules, fields, coefficients, isomorphisms, contractions, or degree; German confirms beliebig at both proizvol- sites.
evidence.cohort_evidence: Czech libovoln- and Slovene poljubn- independently preserve the ljub/vol bridge; cohort presence was used rather than raw token voting.
